themes.name: Light Shard

themes.name: Terrazzo Matins
themes.description: Memphis geometry meets Ando's dawn light — bold geometric type fractures a pale concrete ground while soft gold accents bloom like early morning shafts through raw aggregate.

props.text: Concrete remembers the night. Gold remembers the sun. Terrazzo holds both — fractured, patient, luminous at dawn.
Memphis geometry fractures a pale concrete ground.

themes.name: Botanical Telegraph
themes.description: Art Nouveau's sinuous botanicals meet a dawn information index — jewel-toned tendrils climbing a misty grid, structured yet alive.

props.text: Jewel-toned tendrils climb a misty grid — Art Nouveau's living line meets the dawn information index. Structured. Breathing.

themes.name: Asphalt Blossom
themes.description: The quietude of a Tokyo dawn — rain-slick charcoal dissolving into soft rose light, where grid precision meets atmospheric stillness.

props.text: Tokyo at first light — charcoal dissolving into rose. Grid precision, atmospheric stillness. A city that holds its breath.

themes.name: Graphite Matins
themes.description: Raw concrete stillness meets a single blade of morning light — structural type, pencil-gray surfaces, and one warm gold accent carry the weight.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: Concrete holds its breath. One gold thread catches the first light. Everything else is pencil and patience.

themes.name: Amber Circuit
themes.description: Graphic poster energy channeled through Tokyo rain-slick contrasts — warm amber ground against deep indigo geometry, where condensed type hits like neon on wet asphalt.

props.text: Tokyo rain-slick at 2 AM. Warm amber bleeds into indigo geometry — condensed type hits the wet asphalt like neon. No softness. No apology.
Graphic poster energy — condensed, deliberate, electric.

themes.name: Magenta Voltage
themes.description: Neon-drenched energy channeled through sharp material contrasts — hot pink slashing across deep charcoal, every card edge a deliberate cut.

props.text: Hot pink doesn't ask permission. It cuts through charcoal like a laser tag through smoke — every edge deliberate, every card a statement. This is UI as electric event.
Sharp edges. Louder presence. No apologies.
